worldcombat.skill.icywind.summary: Breathes out a travelling wall of freezing air that rolls forward along the ground as a corridor: foes it sweeps are chilled and lose Speed, and the ground it crosses is left frosted. Deep Freeze is shorter and colder with one extra Speed stage; Wide Freeze reaches further and broader.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.use.0: Chill several foes lined up in front of you
worldcombat.skill.icywind.use.1: Clip the Speed of fast foes charging in
worldcombat.skill.icywind.use.2: Seal a passage with the line the front travels
worldcombat.skill.icywind.use.3: Slow a target from range before your team finishes it
worldcombat.skill.icywind.description.0: Each foe the front sweeps takes about %1$s damage; the target's special defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.description.1: The front runs forward %1$s blocks, about %2$s blocks half-wide, crossing the whole corridor within %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.description.2: Chilled targets lose %1$s Speed stage(s); on Pokemon this is the native stage, on other combatants the movement-speed attribute.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.description.3: The ground it crosses is left with about %2$s frosted blocks for %1$s s, then the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.option.on: Deep Freeze on: range about x0.78, each hit about x1.2 stronger and one extra Speed stage dropped, frost lingers longer, at the cost of +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown, for pinning one tough target.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.option.off: Deep Freeze off (Wide Freeze): the front reaches further, covers wider and casts faster, at the cost of about x0.95 damage and one Speed stage, for sweeping an area or catching fast foes.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.growth.0: At level %1$s the chill rises to %2$s power and the front reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.icywind.preference.dee: On: the front shortens to about x0.78, each hit about x1.2 stronger and one extra Speed stage dropped, frost lasting longer, with a longer wind-up and cooldown, for pinning one tough target. Off: it reaches further and wider and casts faster, for sweeping an area or catching fast foes.
The companion only breathes Icy Wind on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher opens earlier from further away.
With this on, the companion raises Icy Wind when another foe stands within 3 blocks of the target, since the corridor can catch a row at once; off keeps the normal attack order.
